name: Restormer
changes: Replace einops/timm helper dependencies with a four-pattern native torch permutation adapter and native initialization/stochastic-depth helpers.
SwinIR meshgrid explicitly uses ij indexing; remove executable upstream demo.
Project tensor contract and dynamic pad/unpad are external subclasses; official state-dict key layout retained.
reference_test: tests/test_transformers.py compares aligned inputs/strict state dicts against retained exact upstream source; tiny test variants are not scientific checkpoints.
